candidates.description: This vector represents Eastern spiritual and philosophical traditions, encompassing Buddhism, Hinduism, and associated meditative practices.
This feature activates on tokens containing the Hindi or Sanskrit aspirated bilabial and retroflex consonant sounds represented by "bh" and "h".
This vector represents the preposition "without" and its translations or morphological components across various Romance and related languages.
This feature represents the letter 'k' and common syllables or suffixes containing it across various words and names.
This vector activates on letters with diacritics and accented characters common in non-English European alphabets.
This vector activates strongly for English words and subwords starting with the letter 'h'.
This vector activates on capitalized and lowercase syllables or short consonantal-vocalic fragments common in proper nouns or foreign names.
This vector represents the letter 'j' and its common tokenization fragments across various contexts.
This vector represents common Italian grammatical words, pronouns, and frequently used adverbs.
Italian contracted and plural definite prepositions.
